title: 完成旅途的最少时间
summary: 多辆公交完成一次行程所需时间固定且可连续出发，求合计完成 totalTrips 次行程的最短时间。
insight: 给定时间 t 可完成的行程数为 sum(t/time[i])，随 t 单调。二分一到最短单程时间乘总行程数。
pitfalls: 累计达到 totalTrips 后可提前停止
求最小可行时间用下中位

solutions.title: 二分总行程产能
solutions.idea: 以时间为答案做单调可行性检查。
steps: trips>=totalTrips 则 right=middle，否则 left=middle+1；返回 left

code.java: class Solution { public long minimumTime(int[] time,int totalTrips){long left=1,right=(long)Arrays.stream(time).min().getAsInt()*totalTrips;while(left<right){long middle=(left+right)/2,trips=0;for(int duration:time){trips+=middle/duration;if(trips>=totalTrips)break;}if(trips>=totalTrips)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return left;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minimumTime(time:IntArray,totalTrips:Int):Long{var left=1L;var right=time.minOrNull()!!.toLong()*totalTrips;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;var trips=0L;for(duration in time){trips+=middle/duration;if(trips>=totalTrips)break};if(trips>=totalTrips)right=middle else left=middle+1};return left} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long minimumTime(vector<int>& time,int totalTrips){long long left=1,right=(long long)*min_element(time.begin(),time.end())*totalTrips;while(left<right){long long middle=(left+right)/2,trips=0;for(int duration:time){trips+=middle/duration;if(trips>=totalTrips)break;}if(trips>=totalTrips)right=middle;else left=middle+1;}return left;} };
